summary.zh: 金钱是组织的通用资源，用于购买手机、推动行动和维持地下网络运转。它能带来灵活性，也可能带来信任代价。
summary.en: Money is the organization's general-purpose resource. It is used to buy phones, support actions, and keep the underground network operating. It brings flexibility, but may carry trust costs.

items.zh: 金钱可以用于黑市购买手机。
items.en: Money can be used to buy phones through the black market.

items.zh: 金钱可用于支持组织行动和后续系统解锁。
items.en: Money can support organization actions and future system unlocks.

items.zh: 金钱让玩家在资源短缺时拥有更多选择。
items.en: Money gives the player more options when other resources are scarce.

items.zh: 当前设计中，金钱可通过向学生收取保护费等方式获得。
items.en: In the current design, money can be obtained through methods such as collecting protection fees from students.

items.zh: 获取金钱过度激进时，可能伤害学生信任。
items.en: Overly aggressive money collection may damage student trust.

items.zh: 金钱来源未来可与事件、交易、控制区域或管理系统联动。
items.en: Future money sources may connect to events, trades, controlled areas, or management systems.

items.zh: 金钱适合解决短期资源缺口，但不能完全替代学生支持。
items.en: Money can solve short-term shortages, but it cannot replace student support.

items.zh: 如果金钱获取方式破坏信任，组织长期稳定会变差。
items.en: If money generation damages trust, long-term stability will suffer.
